court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Learned Judicial Magistrate Additional Mahila Court, Thiruvallur and III-Additional Family Judge at Chennai
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2019. The wife filed a Domestic Violence Case. The husband is unable to travel and attend due to his aged parents being impleaded as party. The wife has to take care of her two-year-old child.

legal_principles.principle: Courts are bound to grant interim maintenance at least for the child even in case the wife is employed.
legal_principles.held: In such circumstances, the Courts are bound to grant interim maintenance at least for the child even in case the wife is employed.
cited_cases: Rajnesh Vs. Neha and another, [(2021) 2 SCC 324]

legal_principles.principle: Once a minor child is to be maintained by the wife, who is unemployed, then the Courts are bound to grant interim maintenance.
legal_principles.held: Once it is brought to the notice this Court that a minor child is to be maintained by the wife, who is unemployed, then the Courts are bound to grant interim maintenance
cited_cases: Rajnesh Vs. Neha and another, [(2021) 2 SCC 324]

legal_principles.principle: The domicile or citizenship of the opposite party is immaterial in a case like this.
legal_principles.held: The domicile or citizenship of the opposite party is immaterial in a case like this.

legal_principles.principle: The residence of the wife determines the question of jurisdiction.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, Section 19 has to be given a purposeful interpretation. It is the residence of the wife, which determines the question of jurisdiction

outcome.final_order: The petition for transfer is filed to withdraw the Domestic Violence Case from the file of the Learned Judicial Magistrate Additional Mahila Court, Thiruvallur and transfer the same to the Learned III-Additional Family Judge at Chennai.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition for domestic violence case
advising on divorce and custody matters
